title: A cost changed from a vendor invoice keeps the line's sell price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part on line 1, category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50, received from a vendor bill at $100.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open the vendor bill the part was received on.
  2. Change the part's cost on the vendor bill to 110.00.
  3. Save the vendor bill.
  4. Open work order 1.
  5. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The vendor bill opens.

Step 2:

  • The cost reads 110.00.

Step 3:

  • The vendor bill saves.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 5:

  • The part's cost reads $110.00 and its sell price stays $121.50 with tier A in Priced by.
  • Its margin falls to ($121.50 − $110.00) ÷ $121.50 = 9.5%.
